Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Devin Booker?

Devin Booker is 29 years old.

Where was Devin Booker born?

Devin Booker was born in Grand Rapids, Michigan.

When was Devin Booker born?

Devin Booker was born on October 30, 1996.

How tall is Devin Booker?

Devin Booker is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Devin Booker weigh?

Devin Booker weighs 206 lbs (93 kg).

Is Devin Booker in the Hall of Fame?

Devin Booker is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Devin Booker drafted?

Devin Booker was drafted by Phoenix Suns, 1st round (13th pick, 13th overall), 2015 NBA Draft.

What position does Devin Booker play?

Shooting Guard and Point Guard.

What is Devin Booker's net worth?

Devin Booker has made at least $270,586,229 playing professional basketball.

How much does Devin Booker make?

Devin Booker made $53,142,264 in 2026.

How many rings does Devin Booker have?

Devin Booker has won 0 championships.

What is Devin Booker's Instagram account?

Devin Booker is on Instagram at dbook.

What schools did Devin Booker attend?

Devin Booker attended Moss Point in Moss Point, Mississippi and Kentucky.

What are Devin Booker's nicknames?

Book, DBook are nicknames for Devin Booker.
